generation.scope: Finite curvilinear graphs on seventeen sites with full middle support force symmetry at opposite rank ten. Rank eleven is excluded there as well: four shared finite marks force all three double points into a common plane, leaving no room for any opposite exceptional mark. An embedded conic pencil charges the double weight of a fixed kernel line, forcing each exceptional mark onto the secant of a length-two scheme supported on nonsimple graph points. At a confluent six-node slice the relative first-jet speed on both hyperplane cuts is identical.

open_mathematics: Resolve the noncurvilinear length-four site using the local Gorenstein pairing and the constraints on pencils projecting into a ruling. Analyze the fully singular commutator cubic when two symmetric nets have commuting intersection.
